scientific_integrity: The proof treats all positive moduli and separates an unrestricted argument from exact finite computational cross-checks. Unreadable primary full text is stated as a priority risk, not ruled out.
scientific_limitations: The finite-field Dickson image-size formula is classical. The independent novelty asserted is the all-modulus exact least period and detailed residue-fiber histogram; a relevant 1991 paper on Dickson polynomials over Galois rings was accessible only through its abstract and could include overlapping prime-power cases. This has not been independently audited.
title: Exact residue fibers of square-pyramidal numbers over all moduli
